## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe what prompted the change and what users observe after it.

## Verification

List the exact checks run and their results. Include sanitized UI screenshots if relevant.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Backend/frontend checks relevant to the change pass.
- [ ] Demo, live and rules-only behavior remains explicit.
- [ ] Authentication, ownership and evidence provenance are preserved.
- [ ] No credentials, runtime databases or private report data are included.
- [ ] Documentation describes current behavior and remaining limitations.
